title: Vistance Networks Reports Q3 2026 Net Sales of $319.7 Million
summary: Vistance Networks reported Q3 2026 net sales of $319.7 million and GAAP EPS from continuing operations of $0.24, and revised its adjusted EBITDA guidance.
body_markdown:
Non-GAAP adjusted net income was $53.0 million, or $0.23 per diluted share, compared with $17.7 million, or $0.06 per diluted share, a year earlier. Non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA increased 128.2% to $56.6 million from $24.8 million. Aurora Networks, the company's reportable segment, reported operating income of $23.0 million, down 9.8% from $25.5 million, and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA of $56.8 million, up 5.0% from $54.1 million.


Chief Financial Officer Kyle Lorentzen said the company is "revising our full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance to $180 million to $200 million, primarily resulting from customer demand being pushed out into 2027." The company also said its Board of Directors approved a share repurchase program of up to $100 million, in addition to $250 million in previously announced repurchase authorizations.


## Why It Matters for VISN


The quarter follows the divestitures of the company's CCS and RUCKUS businesses, and Aurora represents substantially all of its net sales, according to the release. President and Chief Executive Officer Chuck Treadway said ongoing DOCSIS 4.0 deployments and adoption of next-generation intelligent amplifiers supported the business, while "memory chip pressures and customer deployment timing continue to impact near-term performance." The company said Aurora orders increased 41% from a year earlier and backlog totaled $410 million, up 3%.
